title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 13-16 (Svaha, Svadha, Sudha, Dhanya)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 13 to 16: Svaha, Svadha, Sudha, Dhanya, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 13 to 16 with meaning
caption: Names 13 to 16 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 13 to 16**: **Svaha, Svadha, Sudha, Dhanya**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Svaha, Svadha, Sudha, Dhanya.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Svaha** means **Offering to the gods**. Svaha is the call with which an offering reaches the gods in a yajna.
**Svadha** means **Offering to ancestors**. Svadha is the word of offering to the ancestors.
**Sudha** means **Nectar**. Sudha is nectar; her grace is said to nourish like amrit.
**Dhanya** means **The Blessed One**. Blessed and fulfilled, and a giver of fulfilment to devotees.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
